answer: The node plants five answers it already graded, hidden unmarked among real submissions. An identity gains weight only when its scores on those hidden five match its own grades, so a farm must read and judge every answer instead of stamping. Fifty clones each need 40 minutes of honest grading to pass, 200 hours a week at $8 an hour, around $1,600, for a pool share worth a few POA. An honest peer grades 10 answers in an hour and loses nothing. Reading is the whole job, so no canyon of shortcuts, and the planted seeds stand like cedar among willow until the farm cannot tell them apart.
